content:
**Mutt Chops** are a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

Mongrel Dog Meat which has been cooked, making it safer to eat and improving its nutritional value. It will eventually spoil if not eaten quickly enough.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Mongrel Dog Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Mongrel Dog Meat | | Mutt Chops (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up Mongrel Dog Meat for the first time.
